A '''[[Wampa/Legends|wampa]]''' fought in [[the Cauldron]] arena on the planet [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], at the same time that [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] entered the battle. The wampa attempted to kill Ventress after she had slain all the other gladiators, but before it could do so, it was cut down by [[Giant Flog]].

==Biography==
It was a member of the [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]],<ref name="SW" /> a burly and vicious [[Primate/Legends|primate]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that inhabited the ice-covered world of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. These intimidating creatures had become popular prey for big-game [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] and had also been spotted in illegal [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] games that appeared on a number of [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim worlds]].<ref name="NEG">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Apparently, that was how this particular wampa eventually ended up in [[the Cauldron]] arena on the planet [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]]<ref name="CW" /> shortly after the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The Cauldron was the largest [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] pit on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], filled with violent warriors, where war barons and generals sought out the best combatants who would win their wars.<ref name="DBR">{{DB|location|rattatak|Rattatak}}</ref> Therefore, many gladiators<ref name="CW" /> entered a deadly free-for-all battle,<ref name="EGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> but it was a rare gladiator indeed who could survive multiple fights there.<ref name="DBR" />

[[File:KnockWampa.jpg|230px|left|thumb|Giant Flog knock a wampa aside with a craggy hunk of stone]]
During one battle, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] attended the match of the Cauldron, hoping to find a new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] among the fighters. Soon, the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] entered the arena and, in a short time, defeated most of the remaining gladiators. The survivors united for a single attack against Ventress, but she used the [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to crush stone debris from the ceiling onto their heads. The wampa was the only one who managed to get close enough to Ventress to strike. However, at that very moment, a gladiator<ref name="CW" /> known as [[Giant Flog]]<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|giantflog|Giant Flog}}</ref> knocked the creature aside with a craggy hunk of stone he was using as a weapon and then continued the battle with Ventress.<ref name="CW" />

==Personality==
[[File:CauldronWampa.jpg|200px|right|thumb|A wampa in the Cauldron]]
It was a [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]].<ref name="SW" /> Members of this species usually stood up to three [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and possessed razor-sharp claws and [[Tooth/Legends|fangs]]. Wampas that had passed puberty typically had jagged, curving horns on their heads that continued to grow larger and more imposing with age. They were also covered in thick white [[Hair/Legends|fur]] that blended perfectly with the icy wastelands of their [[Hoth/Legends|native planet]].<ref name="NEG" />

During the battle in the arena, this wampa wore a tattered loincloth, and a coiled chain hung from its neck.<ref name="CW" />

==Behind the scenes==
This gladiator first appeared as an unnamed background character in the [[Chapter 6 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|sixth chapter]]<ref name="CW" /> of ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'', an animated television micro-series<ref name="Chapter Archive">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/microseries/chapter/archive.html|text=View ''Clone Wars'' Chapter Archive}}</ref> produced by [[Cartoon Network]] Studios<ref name="Volume One">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Volume One|''Star Wars: Clone Wars'' Volume One]]</ref> and originally aired on [[November 14]], [[2003]].<ref name="TV">{{TVcom|url=shows/star-wars-clone-wars/chapter-vi-276612|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars - Season 1, Episode 6: Chapter VI}}</ref> Unlike other background characters from the same chapter, who were given at least a name in later sources, this gladiator's history remained unrevealed. Despite this, the article ''[[Galactic Gladiators: Great Warriors of Star Wars]]'', published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]], confirmed that this gladiator was indeed a wampa.<ref name="SW" />
